meaning: Payload rejected because its declared checksum did not match the bytes received
first action: Re-upload the payload; do not retry the same request

meaning: Document exceeded the per-file size ceiling
first action: Split the document or raise MAX_UPLOAD_MB

meaning: No worker accepted the job within the placement window
first action: Check worker pool capacity before retrying

meaning: Job was placed twice because a heartbeat was lost mid-placement
first action: Deduplicate by job id; the second result is discarded

meaning: Write quorum not reached on the primary shard
first action: Wait for the shard to recover; writes are rejected not queued

meaning: Read returned a tombstone for a key that should exist
first action: Escalate to the storage owner with the key and timestamp

meaning: Bearer token was valid but carried no permission tags
first action: Reissue the token with an explicit tag list

meaning: Token signature verified against a retired signing key
first action: Rotate the caller to the current key; the retired key stops working in 14 days

meaning: Usage record arrived after the billing period closed
first action: Record lands in the next period; no manual adjustment needed

meaning: Currency conversion rate was stale by more than 24 hours
first action: Refuse the invoice and refresh the rate table

meaning: Metric cardinality exceeded the per-tenant limit
first action: Drop the offending label before re-enabling the exporter

meaning: Trace was sampled out but its child spans were not
first action: Fix the propagation header; the trace is unusable as recorded
